the proposed structures can be designed such that the Stark effect and the peak intersubband transition are simultaneously maximized in a given electric field range, and the proposed method can be used for optimization of more complex quantum well structures.
the optimal quantum well profile is a function of the applied electric field, and the optimal profile depends on the desired operating bias field range.
